title: Speaking — Lending a hand at events
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on lending a hand at events.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
Have you ever helped to organise an event?
Which roles do you enjoy taking in group activities?

part2.topic: Describe an event that succeeded because many people helped.
part2.closing: and explain why their cooperation was important.

questions: How can event organisers recognise the work of volunteers?
What can make it difficult for small community groups to organise large events?
How has everyday life connected with lending a hand at events changed for people of different ages?
